study type: Methodology Development (with illustrative re-analysis of existing cross-sectional datasets)
cohort: The study's method was applied to four real microbiome datasets investigating associations between microbiome composition and host phenotypes like smoking status, delivery mode, type 1 diabetes, and human immunodeficiency virus status.
finding: The developed microbial group association test, MiHC, robustly adapts to diverse phylogenetic relevance and sparsity levels, maintaining high power with correct type I error controls in simulations.
